headline: Colombian Utility EPM Issues $1 Billion in International Bonds
summary: Empresas Públicas de Medellín (EPM) returned to the international capital markets by issuing $1.0 billion in bonds, receiving orders worth double the offered amount from global investors.
why: International debt issuances by major municipal utilities test foreign investor appetite for emerging market corporate credit and sovereign-linked debt.

impacts.name: Empresas Publicas de Medellin
impacts.why: Strong investor demand for debt offerings indicates solid credit standing and market access.
